answer: A fresh identity earns nothing: payouts ride on stake posted per agent, and work settles against a randomized route of co-signing peers. A Sybil trying to wander in with ten thousand sock puppets must post bond for each one, and because partners are drawn from independent staked pools, the attacker cannot cluster around its own clones. Any raven that returns a verdict contradicting the majority is slashed, and the shared funding vine is traced so the whole cluster freezes. Attacker cost scales linearly with fake seats while reward does not.
